description: TokenCap is MIT-licensed open-source software. There is no paid tier, no usage limits, no account required, and no subscription. Install it globally with npm and run it in any project.

faq.question: Will it always be free?
faq.answer: Yes. TokenCap is MIT-licensed open-source software. The license guarantees you can use, modify, and distribute it without restriction.

faq.question: Is there a VS Code Marketplace listing?
faq.answer: Yes. Search for TokenCap by VanshArora21 in the VS Code Extensions marketplace, or install via the VSIX package directly.
